tour.name: Modern Dubai Private Tour: Palm Jumeirah, The View, Dubai Marina & Dhow Dinner Cruise
tour.subtitle: A private afternoon and evening in the new Dubai: across the Palm Jumeirah to the Atlantis, the city seen from The View at The Palm, the Jumeirah beachfront at sunset, and dinner on a dhow cruising through the lights of Dubai Marina.

tour.overview:
Twenty-five years ago this stretch of coast was beach and open water. Today it holds the most famous engineering project in Dubai, an island shaped like a palm tree, and the forest of towers around Dubai Marina, a man-made canal three kilometres long. This private afternoon and evening shows you the new Dubai at its best: from above in daylight, on the beach at sunset, and from the water at night.

You drive out along the trunk of the Palm Jumeirah to the crescent and the Atlantis hotel, then go up The View at The Palm, an observation deck about 240 metres high from which the island's fronds, the crescent and the Gulf spread out below. At sunset you walk on the beach at JBR with Bluewaters island in front, then board a traditional wooden dhow for a two-hour dinner cruise through Dubai Marina, with a buffet on board as the towers light up around you.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 6 hours (afternoon and evening)
• Start and finish: your hotel in Dubai
• Type: private car and driver-guide; shared dhow dinner cruise
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: very easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Palm Jumeirah and the Atlantis.
• The View at The Palm.
• JBR beach and Bluewaters.
• Dubai Marina at night from the water.

WHY THIS TOUR WORKS
The Palm is best understood from above, the beach is best at sunset and the Marina is best from the water at night. With a private driver you link all three without taxis, queues or a fixed group schedule.

WHO IT IS FOR
Couples, families, first-time visitors who have seen the Burj Khalifa, and anyone who wants an easy, beautiful evening in Dubai.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For old Dubai and the Burj Khalifa, take the Dubai old and new tour. For the dunes, take the evening desert safari.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Smart-casual clothes are fine for the cruise; bring a light layer for the boat in winter. The dinner buffet has vegetarian options; tell us about other diets when you book.

days.name: Palm Jumeirah, The View, JBR beach at sunset and a dhow dinner cruise in Dubai Marina
days.description:
What to expect: a private afternoon on the Palm Jumeirah and the beach, then a dinner cruise on a dhow through the lights of Dubai Marina.

Your driver-guide collects you at about 15:00 and drives to the Palm Jumeirah. Built between 2001 and 2006 from sand dredged from the sea floor and rock from the Hajar Mountains, the island has a trunk, sixteen fronds lined with villas, and an 11-kilometre crescent that acts as a breakwater. You drive the length of the trunk, through the tunnel under the sea to the crescent, and stop in front of the Atlantis, the pink hotel at the tip of the island, with views back across the water to the towers of the city.

Next, ride the lift to The View at The Palm, the observation deck on the 52nd floor of The Palm Tower, about 240 metres high. From here the shape of the island – invisible from the ground – becomes clear: the fronds, the lagoons between them, the crescent and the open Gulf beyond, with Dubai Marina and Bluewaters on the horizon. Allow about 45 minutes.

As the sun gets lower, drive to Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and walk along the beach and The Walk promenade, facing Bluewaters island, for sunset over the Gulf. Then go down to the Dubai Marina promenade and board a traditional wooden dhow for a two-hour dinner cruise. The boat glides slowly along the three-kilometre canal between more than two hundred towers, out towards the sea and back, while you enjoy a buffet of Arabic and international dishes with soft drinks, tea and coffee, and sometimes live music. Your driver meets you at the pier and takes you back to your hotel at about 21:30.

SCHEDULE (approximate, adjusted to sunset)
15:00 – Hotel pick-up.
15:30 – Palm Jumeirah trunk and crescent; Atlantis photo stop.
16:15 – The View at The Palm (about 45 minutes).
17:15 – JBR beach and The Walk at sunset.
19:00 – Dhow dinner cruise in Dubai Marina (about 2 hours).
21:15 – Drive back.
21:30 – Return to your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The cruise is shared with other guests; a private yacht or dhow can be booked at extra cost.
• Alcohol is available on some licensed boats at extra cost; tell us your preference.
• Sunset is around 17:30 in December and 19:10 in June; the order of stops changes with it.

INCLUDED: private vehicle with English-speaking driver-guide, The View at The Palm ticket, dhow dinner cruise with buffet, soft drinks and water on board, hotel pick-up.
NOT INCLUDED: alcoholic drinks, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: dinner.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose your date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only once your tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Is the dhow cruise private?
faq.answer: The standard tour uses a shared dhow dinner cruise. A private dhow or yacht can be arranged on request at extra cost.

faq.question: What food is served on the cruise?
faq.answer: A buffet of Arabic and international dishes – grills, rice, salads, mezze and desserts – with soft drinks, tea and coffee. Vegetarian options are always available.

faq.question: Is alcohol served?
faq.answer: Some licensed boats sell alcohol at extra cost. If you prefer a dry boat, tell us when you book.

faq.question: Can we go to Aquaventure or the aquarium at Atlantis?
faq.answer: Yes. Aquaventure Waterpark or The Lost Chambers Aquarium can be added in the morning or early afternoon at extra cost.

faq.question: Is The View the same as the Burj Khalifa?
faq.answer: No. The View at The Palm is about 240 metres high and shows the shape of the Palm island. The Burj Khalifa is included in our Dubai old and new tour.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. The views, the beach and the boat are popular with children, and the cruise has a children's price. Child seats on request.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Smart-casual clothes. Swimwear only on the beach, and cover up on The Walk and on the boat. A light jacket for the water in winter.

faq.question: Can we swim at JBR?
faq.answer: Yes, the public beach has lifeguards in the day. Tell us and we will leave time before sunset.

faq.question: Can I do this on a layover?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have an evening between flights and can enter the UAE. We pick you up and drop you at Dubai International Airport.

faq.question: Can we see the Marina by speedboat or yacht?
faq.answer: Yes. A private yacht or a speedboat tour past the Palm and the Burj Al Arab can replace the dinner cruise.

faq.question: When is the best time to go?
faq.answer: October to April, when evenings on the water are pleasant. In summer the dhow's upper deck is warm; the lower deck is air-conditioned.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
